entries.title: Old copies cleaned up, shows as installed
notes: Removes leftovers of earlier installs each time it starts: old downloaded or unzipped copies in Downloads and on the Desktop, RBV Browser.bat, old shortcuts, and a startup entry pointing at an old copy. Each one is listed in Advanced › Logs.
Your browser logins and settings are never touched.
Tells Claude Control it is installed, so the Apps menu shows it with its version.

entries.title: Installed like any Windows app
notes: Listed in Settings › Apps as RBV Control by One Development, with the version that is running.
The Start menu entry is now in a One Development folder.
Uninstall from Settings › Apps removes it cleanly; your settings and browser logins are kept.

entries.title: Claude can read web pages on its own (server only)
notes: Claude can read a web page's text with a real browser on the server, without your laptop. It never tries to get past a site's bot or login wall.
Nothing changed in the app itself, so there was no app update for this version.

entries.title: The first major release
notes: 0.13.0 as you accepted it on Windows, released as 1.0.0.

entries.title: Restore brings the browser back
notes: Restoring the docked panel from the taskbar brings the browser back and docks to it again.
The Connection page shows the link as three stations on one rail that light up when connected.
The app says "the server" everywhere it used to say "the Dell".

entries.title: X quits, minimise together
notes: The window's X quits the app, after asking.
Docked: minimising the panel or the browser minimises both.
Dropdowns are readable in dark mode, and the live view can be closed.

entries.title: One install, updates from the server
notes: The app installs itself to one place, so Windows keeps your taskbar and tray choices across versions.
Updates come from the server with the Update button. No more downloading zips.

entries.title: Hide the browser, live view
notes: Hide browser takes the browser off screen while the app shows a live view of it.
Quitting the app closes the RBV Browser too.

entries.title: Opens docked
notes: The app opens as a slim panel beside the browser, and every page fits that width.
Home shows a live view of the browser.

entries.title: Dock beside the browser
notes: The panel can dock to the side of the browser and follow it.
The emblem on Home shows when the link is up and when data is moving.

entries.title: The browser journey
notes: A record of what happened in the RBV Browser (tabs, sites, sign-ins, downloads) and whether you or Claude did it.

entries.title: RBV Control with a permission gate
notes: RBV Control asks you before Claude can use your browser: Off, Ask first, or Always.
